justification: Row 4 of this board is '#.#####.#': every cell is wall except columns 1 and 7. The start is on row 1 and the goal on row 5, so every route crosses row 4, and it can only cross at (4,1) or (4,7). Declaring a loss on both cells cuts the board in two. This is a separation argument read off the layout -- no path is enumerated, and the two cells are exactly the frontier.
